title: TECC GT 1.2 Coils - 2 Pack
description: Designed for use with the TECC Specter tank 2ml, these replacement 1.2ohm coils deliver incredible flavour and longevity. These 1.2ohm GT coils offer a super-satisfying mouth-to-lung style vape full of flavour. These coils are also push-to-fit making them easy to install into the TECC Specter Tank with zero mess. The TECC GT Coils are especially suited for MTL vaping when paired with Classic/High PG , 50/50 and Nicotine Salts e-liquids. Features Compatible with TECC Specter Tank 2ml
